identity: A fourth primary-school Islamic-education worksheet in the same series as doc_a17df83313f0, doc_a83273e31ee3 and doc_c626796ad5b3 (all 100.0), on the revelation, Surat al-Sharh and Surat al-Kawthar: 20 items, one per line, eleven sahh/khata true-false and nine three-way choices.
law: MCQ BANK (section I), closed genre: I2 stem ends where the siblings begin, I3 every option its own unit, I5 internal wa never cuts, 0h never cut inside a stem. Three options on every multiple-choice item, two on every true-false one - the per-document constant of 1z. 163 real tokens / 69 units = 2.4 per unit.
reasoning: Six dangling stems, four of them dialects already collected in 1z and two worth noting. @66 fi, @110 sayyidina (dangling idafa head), @126 the single-letter bi, @140 huwa. @116 al-usr TANI is the dangling-finite-verb dialect (the three glosses al-shidda / al-lin / al-khayr follow), first seen at yabda al-qamar hilalan wa-yantahi. @79 wa-umruhu is a dangling coordinated nominal - tazawwaja al-rasul ... wa-umruhu | 35 sana | 20 sana | 25 sana - and the three options are two tokens each, so the counted noun sana belongs to its numeral and is never split off. The trap on this sheet is huwa: at @140 al-Kawthar HUWA ends the stem because three noun-phrase options follow, but at @168 al-abtar HUWA maqtu al-nasl is a complete true-false STATEMENT and huwa stays inside it - the discriminator is what follows, sahh/khata versus three parallel siblings, exactly the min nar / min nur pair I resolved in doc_a83273e31ee3. I5 blocked the two internal waw of the eulogy salla allah alayhi WA sallam.
